about: One supported panel. Read by the firmware YAML (esphome/, !include), tokens/layout.json devices (tools/gen_layout.mjs), the docs site (install page, engine.ts), deploy.yml and the issue templates (boards/templates.mjs). status: target = a release firmware is built for it. memory: keep_pages = how many deck pages the panel keeps built (facet-243). The Guition's CONFIG_SPIRAM_MALLOC_ALWAYSINTERNAL stays in its board package (an sdkconfig string). backlight: floor = the lowest PWM output (0..1, before the pin is inverted) that still lights the glass, measured on the panel at the board package's PWM rate; the board package uses it as min_power, so 1 % on the Backlight slider maps to it (#153). performance: measured, accepted numbers (facet-243 / facet-245). links: where to read about the board (the maker's page when it has one).
name: Waveshare ESP32-P4-86

performance.about: Measured on the panel with 8 pages kept (facet-243, 79cda21): tap to first changed frame 17-37 ms (Calendar the slowest), boot to all pages kept 16.7 s, PSRAM free with all kept 29.26 MB.
